propositions: A stale backup directory .bridge_state.bak-retarget is present in the tickets tree at HEAD carrying ~33 MB of dead files.
The directory is materialized by every worktree checkout and walked by every GHA git add -A, but contributes nothing to ongoing growth.
Removing it must land before epic 0303-692c's reclaim because the reclaim's tree-identity assertion depends on it already being gone.
The .gitattributes glob .bridge_state/* does not match .bridge_state.bak-retarget/*, so no merge-driver consideration applies.
Acceptance requires the directory be absent from HEAD, fresh checkout size drop by >=33 MB, rebar fsck clean, and no code consumer references bak-retarget.
